testdata/base.why: Topcoat's HtmlContext::Text escapes & < AND >, solid's text mode escapes only & and <. A '>' in template text therefore renders as '>' from Topcoat and '>' from the reference. Strictly safer, never unsafe, and permanent -- see fixtures/escaping.json $topcoatDelta.
Nothing in these traces ever emits this op. Present so the test can assert that a rule matching nothing is reported as STALE rather than passing unnoticed.
